analysis.title: "Last Man Standing": BTIG Warns Mag7 Is All That's Left Holding Up The S&P... And Everyone Already Owns It
key_insights: BTIG's Jonathan Krinsky says the S&P 500 sits a few points from a record while memory and semis are weak, semis are on track for a sixth straight down day, and the median stock is in a bear market. Mag7 is the only cohort important to the SPX that has not shown weakness.

Mag7 is also the most widely owned cohort for its perceived safety against rates and geopolitical risk. Krinsky says that if the Mag7 trend reverses, that is likely what causes sustained SPX weakness.
Goldman's prime book net exposure to Mag7 is near 22% of total US exposure, the highest on record, per a post cited in the note.
Krinsky's chart of the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS) shows a breakout above its 2025 and May highs to a fresh record. Mag7 was up roughly 1% on Tuesday while semis fell.

Krinsky has tracked the SOX against its 1999-2000 path and calls the fit 'uncanny'. If the analog holds, semis put in a low within 24 hours, get one final rally, then the selloff accelerates later in October. That coincides with Wednesday's CPI and with hyperscaler earnings in the back half of October.

The software-to-semis ratio (IGV/SMH) is back above its 200-day moving average for the first time in 16 months. A break above its summer highs near 0.20 would, in Krinsky's view, confirm a major inflection with software outperforming semis for months.

Cembalest (JPMorgan Asset Management, 'Califoreboding', Oct 8) says 42 AI stocks account for 60%-80% of S&P earnings growth, price returns and capex since Jan 2024: 67% of price return, 58% of earnings growth and 81% of capex and R&D growth.

Cembalest says 60% of S&P 500 stocks are down 20% or more from their all-time highs while the index is near its high. The Sept 25 reading is at the extreme of every instance since 1990 when the S&P was within 1% of its high.
Only 30% of S&P stocks are outperforming the index on a three-year basis, one of the lowest figures since 1991. The only comparable trough was 1999-2000.

Trailing earnings for Cembalest's 55 AI supply chain companies have roughly quadrupled since March 2023. Earnings for the 190 highest AI adopters are up about 25%, and the lowest adopters are slightly below their starting level (approximate, read off a chart).

The technology share of US GDP growth went from almost nothing in 2022 to roughly a third. Only 20% of US states are growing faster than the national average. Excluding information processing equipment and software, growth is closer to 1-1.5% (approximate).
Data center and power construction spending is up 38% since January 2024. Manufacturing construction is down 28%, commercial real estate down 13% and residential down 6%.

Data center pre-construction planning capacity has fallen from a peak of roughly 62GW to about 49GW (approximate). Cembalest says this is something to watch. Goldman's Rich Privorotsky is concerned about the ability to complete capacity and deliver power relative to expectations.

Bull case: Cembalest notes global tech stocks have been driven mostly by earnings growth rather than multiple expansion, which tends to be less susceptible to rapid declines. Net interest costs are at an all-time low share of corporate profits.
The article notes Goldman estimates Q3 as likely the peak in both S&P earnings growth and hyperscaler capex growth.
Per ZeroHedge's own screen, over the trailing 30 days only TMT and Energy are positive S&P sectors. 85% of S&P 500 names are more than 10% below their all-time highs and 17% are more than 50% below.

Mag7 is making new highs but is the most crowded cohort. A reversal in it is the main risk to the index.

tension_points.bull_case: Mag7 is breaking out to record highs, driven by earnings growth rather than multiple expansion, which Cembalest says is less susceptible to rapid declines. Net interest costs are at an all-time low share of corporate profits.
tension_points.bear_case: Mag7 is the last cohort holding up the SPX and hedge fund exposure is at a record 22% on Goldman's prime book. Breadth is very poor, AI capex is increasingly debt-funded and planning capacity is falling.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A reversal in the Mag7 trend, which Krinsky says would likely cause sustained SPX weakness. Hyperscaler earnings in late October may decide it.

tension_points.bull_case: IGV/SMH is above its 200-day moving average and a break above about 0.20 would confirm software leadership over semis.
tension_points.bear_case: The SOX tracks its 1999-2000 path: a low within 24 hours, one final rally around CPI, then an accelerating selloff later in October.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The SOX deviating from the 1999-2000 path, for example no relief rally followed by a decline in late October. The note does not name an explicit level.
